phrases.en: I'm flying to New York.
phrases.zh: 我要飞纽约。

phrases.en: Just one bag.
phrases.zh: 就一个包。

phrases.en: Window seat, please.
phrases.zh: 靠窗座位，谢谢。

phrases.en: Where is the gate?
phrases.zh: 登机口在哪里？

dialogue.en: Good morning. Passport, please.
dialogue.zh: 早上好，请出示护照。

dialogue.en: Here you go.
dialogue.zh: 给你。

dialogue.en: Any bags to check?
dialogue.zh: 有行李要托运吗？

dialogue.en: Just this one.
dialogue.zh: 就这一个。

dialogue.en: Here's your boarding pass.
dialogue.zh: 这是你的登机牌。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Where is the gate?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，登机口在哪里？

phrases.en: I'm checking in for the 9:40 flight to New York.
phrases.zh: 我要办理 9 点 40 飞纽约的航班值机。

phrases.en: Can I check this bag through to New York?
phrases.zh: 这个包能直挂到纽约吗？
phrases.note: through = 直挂到最终目的地，转机时不用取。

phrases.en: I'd prefer an aisle seat if one's available.
phrases.zh: 如果有的话，我想要靠过道的座位。

phrases.en: How long before boarding should I be at the gate?
phrases.zh: 登机前多久要到登机口？

phrases.en: Is the flight on time?
phrases.zh: 航班准点吗？

dialogue.en: Good morning. Where are you flying today?
dialogue.zh: 早上好，您今天飞哪里？

dialogue.en: New York. I'm on the 9:40 flight.
dialogue.zh: 纽约，9 点 40 那班。

dialogue.en: May I see your passport and confirmation?
dialogue.zh: 可以看一下您的护照和订票确认吗？

dialogue.en: Sure. Here they are.
dialogue.zh: 好的，都在这儿。

dialogue.en: Do you have any bags to check?
dialogue.zh: 有行李要托运吗？

dialogue.en: One suitcase. Can I take this backpack on board?
dialogue.zh: 一个行李箱。这个背包能带上飞机吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, if it fits under the seat. Here's your boarding pass.
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要能塞进座位下面。这是您的登机牌。

dialogue.en: Great. Which gate does it leave from?
dialogue.zh: 好的，从哪个登机口起飞？

phrases.en: I booked basic economy. Does that include a checked bag?
phrases.zh: 我订的是基础经济舱，包含托运行李吗？

phrases.en: My connection in Chicago is only fifty minutes. Is this bag checked through?
phrases.zh: 我在芝加哥转机只有五十分钟，这个包是直挂吗？

phrases.en: If the first flight is delayed, will I be rebooked automatically?
phrases.zh: 如果第一班延误，会自动给我改签吗？

phrases.en: Could you put a priority tag on it? My medication is in there.
phrases.zh: 能贴个优先标签吗？我的药在里面。

phrases.en: Is there any chance of an upgrade?
phrases.zh: 有可能升舱吗？

dialogue.en: Good morning. Reservation number?
dialogue.zh: 早上好，预订号是多少？

dialogue.en: It's K7P2QX. I'm connecting in Chicago at 11:15.
dialogue.zh: K7P2QX。我在芝加哥 11 点 15 转机。

dialogue.en: That's a tight connection. Are you checking any bags?
dialogue.zh: 转机时间很紧。有行李要托运吗？

dialogue.en: Just this one. Can you check it through to New York?
dialogue.zh: 就这个。能直挂到纽约吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, but it may not make the connection. Keep your medication in your carry-on.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但行李可能赶不上。药请放在随身包里。

dialogue.en: Good point. Is there an earlier flight I could take instead?
dialogue.zh: 有道理。有没有更早的航班可以改？

dialogue.en: There's one at 8:55 with a seat open. I can move you, but your bag may arrive later.
dialogue.zh: 8 点 55 有一班还有座位。我可以给您改，但行李可能会晚到。

dialogue.en: That works. Please put a priority tag on the bag.
dialogue.zh: 可以。请给行李贴个优先标签。

dialogue.en: Done. You're on the 8:55. Boarding starts at 8:25.
dialogue.zh: 好了，您改到 8 点 55。8 点 25 开始登机。

dialogue.en: Thanks. I'll head to security now.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，我现在去安检。

asks.en: Can I see your passport?
May I see your passport?
asks.zh: 我可以看一下您的护照吗？

asks.en: Passport, please.
Could you hand me your passport?

listening.pattern: Can I see…? / May I have…? / Could you hand me…? / …, please.
listening.note: Can I 常读成「k'n I」，May I 会连读。

asks.en: Where are you flying today?
What's your destination?
Where are you headed?
What's your final destination?
asks.zh: 您的最终目的地是哪里？

listening.pattern: Where are you flying / headed? / What's your (final) destination?

asks.en: Are you checking any bags?
Do you have any bags to check?
Any bags to check today?
How many bags are you checking?

listening.pattern: Are you checking any bags? / Do you have any bags to check? / How many bags…?

asks.en: Do you have a seat preference?
Window or aisle?
Any preference for a window or aisle seat?
asks.zh: 想要靠窗还是靠过道的座位？

listening.pattern: Do you have a preference? / Window or aisle? / Any preference for…?

phrases.en: I'm dropping off this bag.
phrases.zh: 我来托运这个包。

phrases.en: Is this bag too heavy?
phrases.zh: 这个包超重了吗？

phrases.en: Can I take this on board?
phrases.zh: 这个能带上飞机吗？

phrases.en: Where do I pick it up?
phrases.zh: 我在哪里取行李？

dialogue.en: Place your bag on the scale, please.
dialogue.zh: 请把包放到秤上。

dialogue.en: Sure. Is it too heavy?
dialogue.zh: 好的，超重了吗？

dialogue.en: It's five pounds over.
dialogue.zh: 超了五磅。

dialogue.en: How much is the fee?
dialogue.zh: 费用是多少？

dialogue.en: Thirty dollars. You can pay at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 三十美元，可以在柜台付。

dialogue.en: Okay. Where do I pick it up?
dialogue.zh: 好的，我在哪里取行李？

phrases.en: I already checked in online. Can I just drop this bag?
phrases.zh: 我已经网上值机了，能只托运行李吗？

phrases.en: Do I need to take out my liquids?
phrases.zh: 液体需要拿出来吗？

phrases.en: Can I gate-check this stroller?
phrases.zh: 这个婴儿车能在登机口托运吗？

phrases.en: Is there a fee for a second bag?
phrases.zh: 第二件行李收费吗？

phrases.en: Will it go straight through to Los Angeles?
phrases.zh: 会直挂到洛杉矶吗？

dialogue.en: Are you checking in online or at the counter?
dialogue.zh: 您是网上值机还是柜台值机？

dialogue.en: Online. I just need to drop this bag.
dialogue.zh: 网上。我只用托运这个包。

dialogue.en: Any liquids or batteries in the bag?
dialogue.zh: 包里有液体或电池吗？

dialogue.en: No. Just clothes and a charger.
dialogue.zh: 没有，只有衣服和充电器。

dialogue.en: It's two pounds over. I can let it go this time.
dialogue.zh: 超了两磅，这次可以放您过。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Does it go straight through to Los Angeles?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。会直挂到洛杉矶吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. You'll pick it up at baggage claim in LA.
dialogue.zh: 会。您在洛杉矶行李转盘取。

dialogue.en: Perfect. Have a good one.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，祝您顺利。

phrases.en: The tag says Chicago, but my final destination is Denver.
phrases.zh: 标签写的是芝加哥，但我的目的地是丹佛。

phrases.en: Could you weigh it again? The scale at home said it was under the limit.
phrases.zh: 能再称一次吗？我家的秤显示没超重。

phrases.en: If it's over, can I move something to my carry-on?
phrases.zh: 如果超重，我能拿点东西到随身包里吗？

phrases.en: Is the bag covered if it's delayed?
phrases.zh: 行李延误有赔偿吗？

phrases.en: Can you mark it as fragile?
phrases.zh: 能标成易碎吗？

dialogue.en: This bag is eight pounds over the limit.
dialogue.zh: 这个包超重八磅。

dialogue.en: That's strange. The scale at home said it was fine. Could you weigh it again?
dialogue.zh: 奇怪，我家的秤显示没超。能再称一次吗？

dialogue.en: It's the same. I can charge the overweight fee, or you can move something to your carry-on.
dialogue.zh: 一样。我可以收超重费，或者您拿点东西到随身包里。

dialogue.en: I'll move my shoes. Can I do that here?
dialogue.zh: 我把鞋拿出来。能在这里弄吗？

dialogue.en: Sure. Step over to the side, please.
dialogue.zh: 可以，请到旁边。

dialogue.en: Okay. Also, the tag says Chicago, but I'm going to Denver.
dialogue.zh: 好了。还有，标签写的是芝加哥，但我去丹佛。

dialogue.en: Good catch. Let me reprint the tag.
dialogue.zh: 还好您说了。我重新打一张。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Is the bag covered if it's delayed?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。行李延误有赔偿吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, up to a certain amount. Keep your receipt.
dialogue.zh: 有，有上限。保留好收据。

dialogue.en: Will do. Can you mark it as fragile?
dialogue.zh: 好的。能标成易碎吗？

asks.en: Place your bag on the scale, please.
Could you put your bag on the belt?
asks.zh: 能把包放到传送带上吗？

asks.en: Go ahead and weigh it here.

listening.pattern: Place / put … on the scale. / Go ahead and weigh it.

asks.en: Any liquids or batteries in the bag?
Is there anything sharp or fragile in there?
asks.zh: 里面有尖锐或易碎物品吗？

asks.en: Do you have any lithium batteries packed?

reply.en: No, just clothes and a charger.
reply.zh: 没有，只有衣服和充电器。

listening.pattern: Any liquids / batteries / sharp objects…? / Is there anything…?

asks.en: It's a few pounds over.
This one's overweight.
You're five pounds over the limit.

listening.pattern: It's … over. / You're … over the limit. / This one's overweight.

asks.en: Is this going all the way to Los Angeles?
asks.zh: 这件会一直运到洛杉矶吗？

asks.en: Are you checking it through to your final destination?
asks.zh: 这件会直挂到最终目的地吗？

asks.en: Will you pick it up at your connection?

listening.pattern: Is this going all the way to…? / Are you checking it through to…?
listening.note: through / straight through 都是「直挂」。

phrases.en: Do I need to take off my shoes?
phrases.zh: 需要脱鞋吗？

phrases.en: Can my laptop stay in my bag?
phrases.zh: 笔记本电脑能放在包里吗？

phrases.en: Is this water okay?
phrases.zh: 这瓶水可以吗？

phrases.en: Where do I put my tray?
phrases.zh: 托盘放哪里？

dialogue.en: Please empty your pockets.
dialogue.zh: 请把口袋清空。

dialogue.en: Okay. Do I need to take off my shoes?
dialogue.zh: 好的。需要脱鞋吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, and your belt.
dialogue.zh: 需要，还有皮带。

dialogue.en: Can my laptop stay in my bag?
dialogue.zh: 笔记本电脑能放在包里吗？

dialogue.en: No, put it in a tray.
dialogue.zh: 不行，放到托盘里。

dialogue.en: Got it. Is this water okay?
dialogue.zh: 明白。这瓶水可以吗？

phrases.en: I have a metal hip. Do I need a pat-down?
phrases.zh: 我做过髋关节置换。需要人工检查吗？

phrases.en: Can I opt out of the body scanner?
phrases.zh: 我可以不做身体扫描吗？

phrases.en: I'm traveling with medication. Does it need to be in a clear bag?
phrases.zh: 我带了药。需要放在透明袋里吗？

phrases.en: My bag was flagged. What do I need to do?
phrases.zh: 我的包被拦下了。我需要做什么？

phrases.en: Where can I pick up my tray?
phrases.zh: 我在哪里拿托盘？

dialogue.en: Step through the scanner, please.
dialogue.zh: 请走过扫描仪。

dialogue.en: I have a metal hip. Will that set it off?
dialogue.zh: 我做过髋关节置换，会响吗？

dialogue.en: Probably. You'll need a pat-down.
dialogue.zh: 可能会，需要人工检查。

dialogue.en: That's fine. Can I opt out of the body scanner?
dialogue.zh: 可以。我可以不做身体扫描吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. Wait here and an officer will help you.
dialogue.zh: 可以。在这里等，会有工作人员来。

dialogue.en: Thanks. My bag was flagged. What do I need to do?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我的包被拦了，需要做什么？

dialogue.en: Unzip it and step to the side.
dialogue.zh: 拉开拉链，站到旁边。

dialogue.en: Okay. I have medication in there.
dialogue.zh: 好的，里面有药。

phrases.en: I'd rather not go through the body scanner. Is a pat-down available?
phrases.zh: 我不想做身体扫描，可以人工检查吗？

phrases.en: That's my insulin. Do you need to see the prescription?
phrases.zh: 那是我的胰岛素。需要看处方吗？

phrases.en: My laptop is in a protective sleeve. Can I leave it in?
phrases.zh: 笔记本电脑有保护套，能不拿出来吗？

phrases.en: I'm going to miss my connection. Is there a fast lane?
phrases.zh: 我要赶不上转机了。有快速通道吗？

phrases.en: Can I request a private screening?
phrases.zh: 可以申请私密检查吗？

dialogue.en: Your bag came up flagged. Is there anything sharp in it?
dialogue.zh: 您的包被标记了。里面有尖锐物品吗？

dialogue.en: There's a small scissors in my toiletry bag. Is that a problem?
dialogue.zh: 洗漱包里有一把小剪刀。有问题吗？

dialogue.en: Blades over a certain length aren't allowed. I'll need to take it out.
dialogue.zh: 超过一定长度的刀片不允许。我需要拿出来。

dialogue.en: I didn't realize. Can I mail it to myself instead of losing it?
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。能不扔，寄给自己吗？

dialogue.en: You can use the mail-back service at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 可以在柜台用寄回服务。

dialogue.en: Good. Also, I'm going to miss my connection. Is there a fast lane?
dialogue.zh: 好。还有，我要赶不上转机了。有快速通道吗？

dialogue.en: Not through security, but tell the gate agent when you get there.
dialogue.zh: 安检没有，但到登机口告诉工作人员。

dialogue.en: Okay. One more thing—can I request a private screening?
dialogue.zh: 好。还有一件事，可以申请私密检查吗？

dialogue.en: Of course. Wait by the side and I'll call someone.
dialogue.zh: 当然。在旁边等，我叫人。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I appreciate it.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，非常感谢。

asks.en: Please empty your pockets.
Take everything out of your pockets.
asks.zh: 把口袋里的东西都拿出来。

asks.en: Pockets empty, please.

listening.pattern: Please empty… / Take everything out of… / …, please.

asks.en: Please take off your shoes and belt.
You'll need to remove your shoes.
Shoes and belt go in the tray.

listening.pattern: Please take off… / You'll need to remove… / … go in the tray.

asks.en: Take your laptop out of the bag.
asks.zh: 把笔记本电脑从包里拿出来。

asks.en: Does your laptop need its own tray?
asks.zh: 您的电脑需要单独放一个托盘吗？

asks.en: Please put your laptop in a separate tray.
asks.zh: 请把电脑单独放一个托盘。

listening.pattern: Take … out of… / Put … in a separate tray.

asks.en: Is this water okay?
Any liquids over three ounces?
asks.zh: 有超过三盎司的液体吗？

asks.en: You'll need to throw that water away.

listening.pattern: Is this … okay? / Any liquids over…? / You'll need to…
listening.note: 美国安检限额是 3.4 oz，约 100 毫升。

phrases.en: Is this the gate for New York?
phrases.zh: 这是飞纽约的登机口吗？

phrases.en: When does boarding start?
phrases.zh: 什么时候开始登机？

phrases.en: Can I board yet?
phrases.zh: 我现在可以登机吗？

phrases.en: Where is the restroom?
phrases.zh: 洗手间在哪里？

dialogue.en: Boarding for New York starts at 8:25.
dialogue.zh: 飞纽约的航班 8 点 25 开始登机。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Is this the right gate?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。是这个登机口吗？

dialogue.en: Yes. Have your boarding pass ready.
dialogue.zh: 是。请准备好登机牌。

dialogue.en: Can I board yet?
dialogue.zh: 我现在可以登机吗？

dialogue.en: Not yet. We're boarding families first.
dialogue.zh: 还不行。我们先让家庭登机。

dialogue.en: Okay. Where is the restroom?
dialogue.zh: 好的。洗手间在哪里？

phrases.en: I'm in group 4. When should I line up?
phrases.zh: 我是第 4 组。什么时候排队？

phrases.en: My carry-on is a bit big. Will they gate-check it?
phrases.zh: 我的随身行李有点大。会在登机口托运吗？

phrases.en: Can I move to an earlier flight if there's a seat?
phrases.zh: 如果有座位，我能改早一点的航班吗？

phrases.en: Is the flight boarding on time?
phrases.zh: 航班准点登机吗？

phrases.en: Could you call my name if you need me?
phrases.zh: 如果需要我，能叫我名字吗？

dialogue.en: I'm in group 4. When should I line up?
dialogue.zh: 我是第 4 组，什么时候排队？

dialogue.en: We'll call group 4 after group 3. About ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 第 3 组之后叫第 4 组，大概十分钟。

dialogue.en: Thanks. My carry-on is a bit big. Will they gate-check it?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我的随身行李有点大，会在登机口托运吗？

dialogue.en: It might not fit. We can gate-check it for free.
dialogue.zh: 可能放不下。我们可以免费在登机口托运。

dialogue.en: That works. Is the flight on time?
dialogue.zh: 可以。航班准点吗？

dialogue.en: We're boarding on time, but there's a short delay on the runway.
dialogue.zh: 准点登机，但跑道上会稍微延误。

dialogue.en: Okay. Could you call my name if you need me?
dialogue.zh: 好。如果需要我，能叫我名字吗？

dialogue.en: Sure. Please stay near the desk.
dialogue.zh: 当然。请待在柜台附近。

phrases.en: I was bumped from the earlier flight. Can you check my status?
phrases.zh: 我被从早一班挤下来了。能查一下我的状态吗？

phrases.en: Is there any chance of a seat in premium economy?
phrases.zh: 有超级经济舱的座位吗？

phrases.en: If I volunteer to take a later flight, what compensation is available?
phrases.zh: 如果我自愿改晚一班，有什么补偿？

phrases.en: My connection is tight. Can you ask them to hold the gate?
phrases.zh: 我的转机时间很紧。能让他们等一下吗？

phrases.en: Could you print a paper boarding pass? My phone is dead.
phrases.zh: 能打一张纸质登机牌吗？我手机没电了。

dialogue.en: I was bumped from the 8:55. Can you check my status?
dialogue.zh: 我被从 8 点 55 那班挤下来了。能查一下我的状态吗？

dialogue.en: I'm sorry about that. Let me see what's available.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。我看看有什么可选。

dialogue.en: I have a connection in Chicago at 11:15. Is there any way to make it?
dialogue.zh: 我在芝加哥 11 点 15 转机。有办法赶上吗？

dialogue.en: The next flight gets in at 10:40. It's tight but possible.
dialogue.zh: 下一班 10 点 40 到。很紧，但有可能。

dialogue.en: Can you ask them to hold the gate?
dialogue.zh: 能让他们等一下吗？

dialogue.en: I can add a note, but I can't promise anything.
dialogue.zh: 我可以备注，但不能保证。

dialogue.en: Understood. If I volunteer for a later flight, what compensation is available?
dialogue.zh: 明白。如果我自愿改晚一班，有什么补偿？

dialogue.en: A hotel voucher and a meal coupon.
dialogue.zh: 酒店券和餐券。

dialogue.en: Okay. Could you also print a paper boarding pass? My phone is dead.
dialogue.zh: 好。能再打一张纸质登机牌吗？我手机没电了。

dialogue.en: Of course. Here you go.
dialogue.zh: 当然，给您。

asks.en: Have your boarding pass ready.
Can I see your boarding pass?
asks.zh: 能看一下您的登机牌吗？

asks.en: Please scan your boarding pass here.

listening.pattern: Have … ready. / Can I see…? / Please scan…

asks.en: We're boarding group 3 now.
Group 4, please line up.
We'll start boarding in ten minutes.

listening.pattern: We're boarding group… / Group …, please line up. / We'll start boarding in…

asks.en: Would you like to move to an earlier flight?
asks.zh: 您想改到早一点的航班吗？

asks.en: There's a seat in premium economy if you'd like it.
asks.zh: 超级经济舱还有个座位，您要吗？

asks.en: Are you willing to take a later flight?
asks.zh: 您愿意改晚一点的航班吗？

reply.en: No, thanks. I'll keep my seat.
reply.zh: 不用了，我保留原来的座位。

listening.pattern: Would you like to…? / There's … if you'd like it. / Are you willing to…?

asks.en: Your bag may need to be gate-checked.
asks.zh: 您的包可能需要在登机口托运。

asks.en: That carry-on might not fit.
asks.zh: 那个随身行李可能放不下。

asks.en: We can gate-check it for free at the door.
asks.zh: 我们可以在登机口免费托运。

listening.pattern: … may need to be gate-checked. / … might not fit. / We can gate-check it.

phrases.en: Where is gate 34?
phrases.zh: 34 号登机口在哪里？

phrases.en: I'm looking for baggage claim.
phrases.zh: 我在找行李转盘。

phrases.en: Can you help me?
phrases.zh: 你能帮我吗？

phrases.en: Do I need to go through security again?
phrases.zh: 我需要重新安检吗？

dialogue.en: Excuse me. Where is gate 34?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，34 号登机口在哪里？

dialogue.en: Take the train to Terminal B. It's about ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 坐小火车到 B 航站楼，大约十分钟。

dialogue.en: Do I need to go through security again?
dialogue.zh: 我需要重新安检吗？

dialogue.en: No, stay inside the terminal.
dialogue.zh: 不用，留在航站楼里。

dialogue.en: Great. Where is baggage claim?
dialogue.zh: 好的。行李转盘在哪里？

dialogue.en: It's on the lower level, near exit 3.
dialogue.zh: 在下一层，3 号出口附近。

phrases.en: My flight was delayed. Will I still make my connection?
phrases.zh: 我的航班延误了。还能赶上转机吗？

phrases.en: The board shows a gate change. Where's the new gate?
phrases.zh: 显示牌说登机口变了。新登机口在哪里？

phrases.en: Can you check if my bag was loaded?
phrases.zh: 能查一下我的行李装上飞机了吗？

phrases.en: Is there a shuttle to the other terminal?
phrases.zh: 有去另一个航站楼的摆渡车吗？

phrases.en: Where can I charge my phone?
phrases.zh: 哪里可以给手机充电？

dialogue.en: My flight from Seattle was delayed. Will I still make my connection?
dialogue.zh: 我从西雅图来的航班延误了。还能赶上转机吗？

dialogue.en: What's your connecting flight?
dialogue.zh: 您的转机航班是哪班？

dialogue.en: The 6:20 to Boston.
dialogue.zh: 6 点 20 飞波士顿那班。

dialogue.en: You'll land at 5:45. It's tight, but the gates are close.
dialogue.zh: 您 5 点 45 落地。很紧，但登机口很近。

dialogue.en: The board shows a gate change. Where's the new gate?
dialogue.zh: 显示牌说登机口变了。新登机口在哪里？

dialogue.en: Gate C12. Take the escalator up one level.
dialogue.zh: C12。坐扶梯上一层。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Can you check if my bag was loaded?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能查一下我的行李装上飞机了吗？

dialogue.en: I can see it was scanned. It should be on board.
dialogue.zh: 我看到扫描记录了，应该已经上飞机。

phrases.en: I missed my connection because of the delay. What are my options?
phrases.zh: 因为延误我错过了转机。我有哪些选择？

phrases.en: Can you rebook me on the next available flight?
phrases.zh: 能把我改到下一班有空位的航班吗？

phrases.en: Am I entitled to a hotel if I'm stuck overnight?
phrases.zh: 如果滞留一晚，我有权住酒店吗？

phrases.en: My bag is still in Seattle. Can you file a delayed baggage report?
phrases.zh: 我的行李还在西雅图。能登记行李延误吗？

phrases.en: Could you give me a written confirmation for my insurance?
phrases.zh: 能给我一份书面证明用于保险吗？

dialogue.en: I missed my connection because of the delay. What are my options?
dialogue.zh: 因为延误我错过了转机。我有哪些选择？

dialogue.en: I'm sorry. The next flight to Boston is tomorrow at 7 a.m.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。下一班飞波士顿是明早 7 点。

dialogue.en: Can you rebook me on it?
dialogue.zh: 能把我改到那班吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, I can put you on standby or confirm a seat for a fee.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我可以给您候补，或者付费确认座位。

dialogue.en: What's the fee?
dialogue.zh: 费用多少？

dialogue.en: Eighty dollars. The airline may waive it because of the delay.
dialogue.zh: 八十美元。因为是延误，航司可能会免。

dialogue.en: Please try to waive it. Am I entitled to a hotel if I'm stuck overnight?
dialogue.zh: 请试着免掉。如果滞留一晚，我有权住酒店吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, there's a hotel voucher if the delay is the airline's fault.
dialogue.zh: 有，如果是航司原因，有酒店券。

dialogue.en: Good. My bag is still in Seattle. Can you file a delayed baggage report?
dialogue.zh: 好。我的行李还在西雅图。能登记行李延误吗？

dialogue.en: I can. Keep this claim number for your insurance.
dialogue.zh: 可以。保留这个申报号用于保险。
